Plot the neighbourhood stability of a self-organising map

Source: R/stability_functions.R
eemsom_plot_stability.Rd

A histogram of the neighbourhood stability of all pairs of samples is compared to the distribution expected on a randomly organised map (de Bodt et al. 2002), as in Figure 4B of Ejarque-Gonzalez and Butturini (2014).

Usage

eemsom_plot_stability(x)

Arguments

x

object of class eemsom_stability, see eemsom_stability

Value

a ggplot object

References

de Bodt, E., Cottrell, M., Verleysen, M. (2002). Statistical tools to assess the reliability of self-organizing maps. Neural Networks 15(8-9), 967-978. doi:10.1016/S0893-6080(02)00071-0

Ejarque-Gonzalez, E., Butturini, A. (2014). Self-Organising Maps and Correlation Analysis as a Tool to Explore Patterns in Excitation-Emission Matrix Data Sets and to Discriminate Dissolved Organic Matter Fluorescence Components. PLoS ONE 9(6), e99618. doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0099618

See also

Other stability: eemsom_stability()

Other plots: eemsom_plot_cplane(), eemsom_plot_map(), eemsom_plot_silhouette(), eemsom_plot_training(), ggeem.eemsom(), ggeem.eemsom_regions()

Examples

data(eem_list)

som <- eemsom(eem_list, dim = c(3, 3), rlen = 20, seed = 42)
stab <- eemsom_stability(eem_list, som, nrep = 3, seed = 42)
eemsom_plot_stability(stab)
